summary: requiredAuthCookies returns _session_id so Chrome-profile discovery verifies an Ignition auth cookie is present instead of falling back to raw cookie count.
reason: Greptile PR #1528 P1: requiredAuthCookies always returned an empty slice, so profile discovery never checked for an Ignition session cookie and could import the wrong profile (or report success for one that cannot authenticate) on multi-profile machines. _session_id is Ignition's Rails session cookie, verified against a live authed go.ignitionapp.com tab via CDP Network.getCookies (every other cookie on the origin is analytics).
validated_outcome: Verified _session_id is the sole auth cookie on the live origin; profile discovery loop already consumes the returned set. Build + go vet clean.
